up: Find all distinct compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL3639326'. Return the compound's ChEMBL identifier (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), and canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles). Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then join molecule_dictionary and compound_structures on molregno. Filter strictly by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3639326'. Use DISTINCT to avoid duplicate rows. Do not apply any row limits.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3639326'
